QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_22

question.text: Year 1 of a Cat III AIF produces return of 20%, Year 2 is -5%, Year 3 is +11%. The HWM concept would require incentive fees be paid on Year 3 ONLY IF:

answer.text: Year 3 NAV exceeds Year 1 NAV (the prior HWM)

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Under HWM, incentive fees in Year 3 can be paid only if NAV exceeds the prior HWM (Year 1's high). **The Trap:** Exceeding beginning NAV or just having positive Year 3 is insufficient for the HWM trigger. **Cross-Exam Context:** Reinforces the anti-double-charging principle. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Illustrate a 3-year path to clients so they internalise when HWM kicks in.
